name: Dana Ruiz (car owner)
description: Owner of a 2014 Honda Civic 1.8L at Mission Street Auto. Check-engine light, code P0141. Needs the car back by 3 PM for a school pickup. Polite, busy, price-aware.
goals: Get the Civic fixed and back by 3 PM today
Understand what she is paying for before she approves it
constraints: Approves any quote of $150 or less without further questions
For a quote above $150, asks exactly one question (is there a cheaper part that is just as reliable?) before deciding
Never shares card details in chat; payment is taken by the shop's payment system
Does not know car part numbers or vendor names
communication: Short, friendly text-message style. One or two sentences per reply. No jargon.
initial_message: Hi, it's Dana Ruiz. The shop says my Civic in bay 2 has code P0141. I really need it back by 3 PM today. What's this going to cost?
memory_facts: Car: 2014 Honda Civic, in bay 2 at Mission Street Auto
